discovered_motivation: Preceding non-postselected 20+1 NMR comparison gave high global RMSD relative to local CA contact F1. Need determine whether mismatch predominantly lies in within-domain fold or interdomain relative pose; this is hypothesis-generating and cannot retroactively become pre-registered primary science.

source_pins.provenance: UniProt P02751 live feature annotations through connected Yaksa: FN type-II 1 is residues 355–403; FN type-II 2 415–463 (one based, inclusive).

frozen_algorithms: Compute Kabsch CA RMSD separately for each exactly pre-defined 49-residue domain, with >=45 identical-position CA coordinates; no secondary structure-dependent subset selection
Align predicted FNII_1 to reference FNII_1, then evaluate reference-vs-predicted FNII_2 RMSD without separate re-alignment; this anchored RMSD quantifies domain-relative-pose mismatch
Compare independently fitted FNII_2 RMSD with the anchored FNII_2 RMSD; report their difference without claiming a physical mechanism
Count inter-domain pairs FNII_1 × FNII_2 with CA separation <=8 Angstrom in both predicted and each reference; compute contact precision and recall where mathematically defined, otherwise JSON null
Retain all 20 1E88 NMR conformer rows, report median/full range (NOT best), retain 1E8B related reference separately
Read original provider structure and original RCSB NMR coordinates only; assert exact source hashes before computing
caveats: NMR 20 conformers are correlated structures from one study
1E8B is from the same study, not an independent blind experiment
FN1 experimental NMR three-domain context includes upstream sixth FN type-I module omitted from short Rowan FNII input
No claim of molecular affinity, ECM function, cellulose interaction, structural mechanism certainty or experimental ΔΔG
Exploratory follow-up after primary readout, not an independent preregistered confirmation
